English: Official launch of $5 billion FNRP to support food security across 24 ASAL counties, targeting 5M vulnerable Kenyans.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa FNRP ya dola bilioni 5 ili kusaidia usalama wa chakula katika kaunti 24 za ASAL, ukilenga Wakenya milioni 5 walio katika mazingira magumu.
Ekegusii: Ogochakiwa bene kwa omoroberio oyo FNRP bwe chidola chibilioni 5 erio gokonya okoba gwe chindagera ase chikaunti 24 ase eroro na chinsemo chinyomo, barengete abakenya chomirioni 5

English: The Authority urges firms wishing to engage in parcel and courier services to apply for the requisite licenses from our offices in Nairobi, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nyeri and Mombasa and cautions members of the public to seek parcel and courier services from CA licensed providers only.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka inahimiza makampuni yanayotaka kujihusisha na huduma za vifurushi na usafirishaji wa mizigo kuomba leseni zinazohitajika kutoka ofisi zetu jijini Nairobi, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nyeri na Mombasa na inawaonya wananchi kutafuta huduma za vifurushi na usafirishaji wa mizigo kutoka kwa watoa huduma walio na leseni za CA pekee.
Ekegusii: Abatenereri bobobogoria emesigo basabirwe kwerika neserikari aaria Nairobi, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nyeri na Mombasa erio gwancherwa gokora emeremna gokurera abanto bonsi konyora ogokonywa kwogotoma emesigo yabo goetera baria bakoewa chisatifiketi echio (CA) boka.

English: To ensure public safety during the renovation, the County Government has issued a clear directive: Members of the public have been directed to stay at least 30 metres away from the hospital site.
Kiswahili: Ili kuhakikisha usalama wa umma wakati wa ukarabati, Serikali ya Kaunti imetoa agizo wazi: Wananchi wameagizwa kukaa angalau mita 30 kutoka eneo la hospitali.
Ekegusii: Erio goikerania oborendi obuya chingaki chiokoagacha keboyia chinyomba , eserikari yekaonti yarure omoroberio omoronge: Abanto baboriigwe koba are nase ayio yamaagacho goika oboare bwachifuti 100 korwa ase amaagacho agokorerwa yoboagachi bwenyagitari.

English: CDC launches a campaign promoting hand hygiene to prevent disease spread.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya kuhimiza usafi wa mikono ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa.
Ekegusii: CDC gochaka ekampeini ya ogosiira gosibia amaboko erio gotanga okoambokeria amarwaire.

English: On May 5 2015 KUCCPS opened its portal for 2014 KCSE candidates to apply for TVET diploma and certificate courses with a deadline of June 15 2015.
Kiswahili: Mnamo Mei 5, 2015, KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2014 kuomba kozi za stashahada na cheti cha TVET huku tarehe ya mwisho ikiwa Juni 15, 2015.
Ekegusii: Chitariki isano omotienyi 5 omwaka 2015 ekeombe keria getenenerete kegochora abana gochia chiyunifasiti nechikoregi (KUCCPS) nkiaigorete eintaneti yaye ase abana besekenderi baria bokorete amatemwa a KCSE omwaka 2014 batome ogosaba kwabo ase chikosi chiobundi, nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) ase ekosi yechipuloma naboigo yechisatifiketi nyuma yechitariki 15 chiomotieni 6 omwaka 2015.

English: Protect your agricultural innovations and new varieties by understanding Intellectual Property (IP) rights like patents and plant breeders' rights.
Kiswahili: Linda uvumbuzi wako wa kilimo na aina mpya kwa kuelewa haki za Miliki Bunifu (IP) kama vile hati miliki na haki za wafugaji wa mimea.
Ekegusii: Renda chingecho chia chioboremi amo na embusuri enyia ase okomanya buna okorenda obomanyi bwao (IP) oboronge buna boria bwokorosia egento ekeyia and oboronge bwogokeborana kwebimeri .

English: Indicators of stress:easily irritable,anxious,panic attacks,sleeping problems,social withdrawal,irritability
Kiswahili: Viashiria vya msongo wa mawazo: kukasirika kwa urahisi, wasiwasi, mashambulizi ya hofu, matatizo ya usingizi, kujitenga na watu, kuwashwa
Ekegusii: Ebiorokererio bi'ebirengererio: okokgechigwa bwango, enda egotera amache, chimbaa/obwoba, obokong'u korara, gweatanana na abande, okoromwa.

English: Kenya will adjust curfew hours in Turkana and Kainuk due to improved security.
Kiswahili: Kenya itarekebisha saa za kutotoka nje huko Turkana na Kainuk kutokana na usalama ulioimarishwa.
Ekegusii: Kenya nebangete korigeria keboyia chingaki abanto babwenerete korwa isiko kogenda chinka aaria Turkana na Kainuk ekiagera oborendi bwabeire buya ake.

English: Every child has rights to education, healthcare, and protection. Communities must report violations.
Kiswahili: Kila mtoto ana haki ya kupata elimu, huduma ya afya, na ulinzi. Jamii lazima ziripoti ukiukwaji.
Ekegusii: Kera omwana nare noboronge bwokonyora chisemi, obobwenia, na oborendi. Abanto goika barwe eripoti igoro yotaikeranigwa kwayio.

English: Engage in community programs that systematically root out corruption and rebuild public trust
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika programu za jamii zinazoondoa ufisadi kimfumo na kujenga upya uaminifu wa umma
Ekegusii: Bwaterana nemeroberio yebinyoro eyio egokinana nobokorekanu gati yobogambi koiya obokorekanu na koirania okwegena kwa abanto ase obogambi.

English: Prepare for fees! Support schools by paying fees on time despite funding delays.
Kiswahili: Jiandae kwa ada! Saidia shule kwa kulipa ada kwa wakati licha ya ucheleweshaji wa fedha.
Ekegusii: Eariganie ase bosa! Sira chisukuru ase ogoakana esukuru fisi nonya chibesa chiria esukuru ekoegwa neserikari chiachererirwe.

English: (v) improving market access for the smallholders through better supply chain management. The Vision aims at adding value to our farm and livestock products.
Kiswahili: (v) kuboresha upatikanaji wa soko kwa wakulima wadogo kupitia usimamizi bora wa mnyororo wa ugavi. Maono yanalenga kuongeza thamani kwa mazao yetu ya shambani na mifugo.
Ekegusii: Kwororobia echiro ya abaremi bemegondo emeke na echiro yerigesa riabo goetera obobagi na oboererania bwerigesa riabo as oboikeranu. Ekerenga eke nigo kerengete gokinia ebotoki ase aboremi bwebimeri na etugo amo.

English: Positive parenting reduces abuse risks. Attend government-sponsored parenting programs to learn child protection strategies.
Kiswahili: Uzazi chanya hupunguza hatari za unyanyasaji. Hudhuria programu za uzazi zinazofadhiliwa na serikali ili kujifunza mikakati ya ulinzi wa watoto.
Ekegusii: Oboreri obuya nigo bogokeania abana gokorerwa bobe. Soa gose kabe oyomo ase omoroberio bweserikari gosomigwa chinchera buna oranyare korenda abana.

English: NPS launched an online portal providing access to oversight reports, misconduct statistics, complaint status, and disciplinary actions.
Kiswahili: NPS ilizindua lango la mtandaoni linalotoa ufikiaji wa ripoti za usimamizi, takwimu za utovu wa nidhamu, hali ya malalamiko, na hatua za kinidhamu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabasikari (NPS) giansire obokoreri bweintaneti goikera chiripoti chia' bamongeri buna poilisibagokora emeremo yabo barenge bakorore mamincha, buna ayio agendererete korigererigwa, negeusuro kiarurwe.
